## Result

**No data is available** for the stunting rate in Liechtenstein according to the UNICEF Data Warehouse.

The UNICEF Data Warehouse was queried for the stunting indicator (Height-for-age <-2 SD), which is the standard measure you asked about, but Liechtenstein does not have data available in this system.

This is not unusual: stunting data comes from household surveys (Demographic and Health Surveys, Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys, etc.) that are primarily conducted in low- and middle-income countries where child malnutrition is a public health concern. High-income European countries like Liechtenstein typically do not participate in these international survey programs.

For information about child health and nutrition in Liechtenstein, I recommend:
- Checking the official Liechtenstein health statistics at the national health ministry
- Visiting [data.unicef.org](https://data.unicef.org/) directly for browsing available country coverage
- Contacting Liechtenstein's national statistical office
